information_order: commit this protocol and evaluator before a workflow is permitted to open numeric dataset payloads
inventory names and directory structure only
derive the repository-mentioned exclusion set from committed text plus the explicit exclusion list
select exact object and archive paths deterministically from names only
serialize and hash the selection seal
start a separate evaluator process that may open only the sealed archive paths
score every selected archive without replacement or target-dependent tuning

cohort_selection.selection_rule: ascending SHA-256 rank of protocol_id, object_id, and relative archive path
cohort_selection.object_eligibility: mounted object identifier is absent from every Git-tracked repository text file and from explicit_excluded_object_ids
cohort_selection.unsupported_selected_archive_action: retain as a support failure without replacement

fixed_identity_trajectory.required_contract: finite array with shape (frames >= 4, tracks >= 1, 3) under a trajectory-hint key
fixed_identity_trajectory.optional_validity_contract: boolean array matching the first two trajectory dimensions

packed_visual_hulls.required_contract: frame_indices, point_offsets, and points_world_m arrays with valid packed offsets

normalized_evidence.component_bank: unchanged frozen 15-component robust random-walk endpoint grid
normalized_evidence.weight_rule: softmax(log component prior + cumulative component log evidence / max(valid update count, 1))
normalized_evidence.motivation: remove the implicit independent-observation multiplication diagnosed by the temperature-128 boundary result

aggregation.within_object: mean over the single sealed archive
aggregation.paired_uncertainty: object-level paired bootstrap with 10000 resamples and seed 20260804

success_gates.support: at least 6 sealed objects satisfy one declared numeric representation
success_gates.normalized_vs_cumulative_uncertainty: normalized evidence improves equal-object mean Gaussian NLL and absolute 90-percent coverage error
success_gates.normalized_vs_cumulative_point_non_regre: both available representation-specific point metrics have upper paired 95-percent delta bounds no greater than zero
success_gates.baseline_reporting: persistence and last-supported-residual results are always reported and never hidden by a model-average comparison

claim_boundary: Prospective external-data diagnostic on repository-unmentioned mounted Deform360 object identities selected from names only before numeric payload access. It tests rolling one-step endpoint-motion transfer and normalized evidence scaling. It is not official Deform360 benchmark parity, not proof that the objects were globally unseen outside this repository, not deployment calibration, not intervention prediction, and not a state-of-the-art claim.
